title: Driver Tips on Wayfare Rides: Tip Window and Largest Tip
content:
The tip window and the largest tip accepted on one trip of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** are the same on every ride option.

| Ride option | Tip window (calendar days after drop-off) | Largest single tip on one trip |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Shared | 30 | $100.00 |
| Wayfare Standard | 30 | $100.00 |
| Wayfare Green | 30 | $100.00 |
| Wayfare Comfort | 30 | $100.00 |
| Wayfare XL | 30 | $100.00 |
| Wayfare Black | 30 | $100.00 |
| Wayfare Black SUV | 30 | $100.00 |

- **Tip window**: calendar days after drop-off during which the rider may add a tip.
- **Largest single tip**: largest single tip accepted on one trip, USD.

A tip of $100.00 is within the largest amount; a tip of $100.01 is above it.
